nodes.label: contentSecurityPolicy()
nodes.rationale: Builds a CSP header from a typed directive map; camelCase keys serialise to kebab-case directive names. The header rides on a short-circuit that throws, which matters more here than for the rest of the header bundle because this middleware is the only seam that emits a policy at all.

nodes.label: Helmet-parity CSP baseline
nodes.rationale: useDefaults supplies default-src 'self', object-src 'none', base-uri 'self', frame-ancestors 'self', script-src 'self' and friends; your directives merge over it per-directive, [] removes one, withoutDefaults() emits only what you specify. A policy is too app-specific for the server-wide bundle, so it is deliberately excluded from securityHeaders().

nodes.label: CSP source-token injection guard
nodes.rationale: A source token containing ';', ',' or whitespace throws at construction rather than being emitted, so a directive value can never smuggle a second directive into the header. Per-request nonces are not built in because they need a template/SSR integration the framework lacks; the middleware never overwrites a header the handler already set, so a handler can supply its own.
